title: Battle Result (PROPOSED — not yet persisted)
description: One battle simulation outcome. Currently returned by POST /battle/simulate but NOT persisted. Proposed table: battle_result (seq INTEGER PK AUTOINCREMENT, player_id TEXT NOT NULL, payload TEXT NOT NULL, created_at TEXT NOT NULL). Would enable match history, win/loss tracking, replay review, and ELO/MMR. See backend/src/routes/battle.ts:116-217 for the simulation engine.

player_id.description: Player identifier from X-Player-Id header. The initiating player.

created_at.description: ISO 8601. When the battle was simulated.

$comment: NOT YET IMPLEMENTED. Add to db.ts SCHEMA and persist in /battle/simulate route when ready.
